Is fun but the game have some issues. The only thing I want is for them to fix the AI for traffic or get traffic signals like in Transport Tycoon. Right now is very common to have deadlocks in trains because you can't lay down individual rails, or because you can prioritize the main route over the incoming lines. In traffic for example the cars get waiting for a firefighter to stop the fire to continue, instead of taking the other 5 lines you have available to pass it. Is kinda frustrating at a time.

EDIT: Another thing for example is to limit the reach of services. I got police cars from responding to a call that is 4 tiles away from the origin. So by the time they get there is over, and they are lock on route unable to respond to local calls. So there is a limit of how much your city can grow because sooner or later you get a chain reaction locks everywhere.

Hi. I've been on Reddit for over 7 years now, and before that I was on digg. I remember when reddit was a source of new and interesting content, and seemed to represent the best parts of the internet. That meant original content, well thought out comments, and unique perspectives on current events.

I watched that site turn from an educated forum of ideas where reddiquette meant something, to a free for all of advertising and self promotion. I watched a social group I built around a local reddit community turn to shit and become infested with vile self promoting people who had no interest but their own. They would dominate meetups and shun anyone who didn't fall in line with their own personal desires. I know every social group will eventually reach this critical mass where the negative impact of the group outweighs the positive. I only hope that I can have a few good years out of this site.

I expect that if voat becomes popular, it will turn to shit just like reddit did within a few years, and we will have an exodus to the next site. I also expect, though, that reddit will hold its place as "the frontpage of the internet" for quite a while to come.
Well,for the time being enjoy your stay here while you can and don't worry too much about it, I recommend /v/ideasforvoat if you have any idea that you want to be implemented in Voat.
